objective: Implement deterministic, integrity-verified canonical ledger replay and verify-before-retire archive authority without introducing a second write path.
invariants: Replay consumes canonical ledger sequence order only and rejects gaps, duplicates and reordering.
Every replayed payload and event envelope is hash-verified before upcast or state application.
Upcasters and reducers are deterministic, synchronous and forbidden from external I/O.
Replay never mutates the canonical ledger or production authority state.
Archive creation is deterministic and content-addressed.
Active segment retirement is forbidden until archive read-back, digest, count and boundary verification succeed.
Any partial write, truncation, corruption, mismatch, cancellation or dependency failure fails closed and preserves the active segment.
All evidence records use canonical serialization and contain no secrets or inline binary payloads.
outOfScope: Durable authority command and receipt protocol
